guarda.grito: Close the line, close the line!
bark.manha: The rooster crowed twice. Either rain or death.
Hot bread in the square, first come first served.
Sleep well, {nome}? I didn't. The dogs howled all night.
A morning this cold calls for broth.
Is the gate open yet? The woodcutters want to leave early.
bark.dia: Sun's high. Good for drying leather, bad for whoever works the forge.
If you go into the woods, be back before dark.
The market is packed today. Anyone seen Thorin?
They say in Askavik even the alleys are paved with stone.
Who dropped a bucket in the well? Again?
bark.noite: Close the window, it's night already.
At night not even the dog goes out alone.
Did you hear that? No… must have been the wind.
Light the lamp, the dark here has an owner.
Come back early tomorrow, {nome}. The night charges whoever walks in it.
The owls are quiet. That's never good.
bark.frio: This cold gets into your bones and moves in.
Got firewood at home? I don't.
Snow before the week is out, I'd bet my cap.
Rub your hands, {nome}, or the sword will slip.
bark.calor: What heat. The beer gets warm before it reaches your mouth.
Even the flies are tired today.
In the shade of the temple you can breathe.
bark.lua: The moon is bleeding… Shut everything, for the Eye's sake.
Blood Moon night: the Count's spawn come out to hunt.
My grandfather used to say: when the moon turns red, the wolf remembers it was once a man.
Don't stare at it, {nome}. They say it stares back.
Tonight even the dead in the graveyard are restless.
bark.aurora: Dawn Day! Smell that? It's Auréon passing by.
The paladins have been singing since early. Makes you want to believe.
Today any kindness counts double. Make the most of it, {nome}.
See the sparkles falling? My daughter wants to keep one in a jar.
bark.combate: By the Eye, don't let it reach the houses!
Yes! One more like that and the village sleeps in peace.
bark.ferido: You're bleeding, {nome}. Sit down a moment.
The healer has ointment. Go before you drop.
With that face even I could beat you. Eat something!
Don't die on my doorstep, please.
bark.montado: Fine horse. Take care of it, good horses don't grow on trees.
Easy with that beast in the square, there are children!
How much did that mount cost? No, don't tell me. I'll cry.
bark.pet: What a lovely {pet}! Can I pet it?
That {pet} already stole bread off my table.
Take good care of {pet}, a loyal animal is worth more than gold.
bark.novato: You the new one? You look like you woke up yesterday.
First time in Karmika? Don't eat the blue mushrooms.
Take it easy, {nome}. Rats bite too.
bark.veterano: They say you've brought down something big, {nome}.
Look who's back. The village is safer with you here.
My son wants to be like you. I told him he has to eat his greens first.
bark.luz: The village speaks well of you, {nome}.
Good people still exist. May the Eye keep you, {nome}.
The children say you're a hero. Don't let it go to your head.
bark.sombra: …don't talk to me. I heard what you did.
Hide the purse, Marta, look who's coming.
Your eyes have changed, {nome}. The dogs can tell.
There's more in your shadow than there is in you.
bark.vam: He didn't eat a thing at the tavern. Again.
Garlic on the door, Marta. Now.
bark.lob: Smells like wet dog… is that you?
Did your eyes just glow? No, must have been the lantern.
The village dogs go quiet when you pass. Strange.
bark.mag: A mage in the village! Think he'll fix the well with magic?
Keep that staff away from my chickens.
bark.bru: Cross yourself, girl. It's the warlock.
They say a warlock pays the price with his own shadow.
I won't take your coin. What if it's cursed.
bark.pal: A paladin of Auréon! Will you bless my son?
With you here I sleep with the window open.
The armor shines even at night, look at that.
bark.cac: A hunter from the Bastion… who died?
If you're here, there's a demon nearby.
Silver on the belt. So what they say is true.
bark.tecno: What's that noise in your chest? A tin heart?
The Academy sent another one. Careful with that reactor near the hay.
My grandfather said machines have no soul. Do you?
bark.gue: A warrior of the North! Odin still sends his own.
Easy with that axe, the village is small.
Nice scars. How many enemies was that?
bark.rep_alta: Look who's here! Sit down, {nome}, make yourself at home.
My mother prays for you every night. Really.
If you need anything, just ask. Anything.
The children play at being you, did you know?
I saved the best piece of bread for you.
bark.rep_baixa: The guards have their eye on you.
Get out of here before I call someone.
No shopkeeper here will give you a fair price.
bark.despedida: So it's true? You're leaving Karmika?
The village will be quieter without you, {nome}.
Take a piece of cheese for the road. Take it!
I'll miss you. Don't tell anyone I said that.
Come back now and then, you hear? Promise.
Garrick pretends otherwise, but he's proud.
bark.festa: More beer here! The dwarf brought a barrel for the whole village!
This meat is divine, who roasted it?
Somebody stop Bento before he sings again.
Dance, {nome}! Tonight the party is yours!
bark.volta: You're back! The party is still the talk of the tavern.
Well look at that, the hero of Karmika home again!
Tell us, tell us: what's the world like out there?
Your seat at the table is still saved.
Lúcia will be happy to see you. Bento too.
bark.r_guarda: Stay inside the walls after sundown, {nome}.
Seen anyone strange on the road? Let me know.
I've guarded this gate since before you could walk.
bark.r_ferreiro: The forge doesn't wait. Cold iron doesn't forgive.
Bring ore and I'll work miracles.
That blade of yours needs an edge, you know?
bark.r_taverna: Stew of the day: whatever was there yesterday.
Karmika beer, best in the valley. The only one, but the best.
Sit down, {nome}, the corner table is free.
bark.r_mercador: Good price, today only. Tomorrow too.
I buy everything that shines and half of what doesn't.
Gold in one hand, goods in the other. Simple.
bark.r_fe: The Eye of Marghar sees what you do, {nome}. Everything.
Pray before you sleep. Those who don't pray, dream.
Every soul comes back. Mind what you carry.
fofoca.luz: Good people. Helped the miller's widow without asking for a thing.
They say {nome} never leaves anyone behind.
The Eye must like them. Luck walks alongside.
Yesterday {nome} paid for the whole table's beer.
And didn't even brag about it. That's rare.
…the guard would have to find other work.
My daughter wants to be like {nome}.
She could have a worse example.
fofoca.neutro: {nome}. Nobody really knows where they came from.
{nome} goes armed even to buy bread.
In times like these, so would I.
People like that never stay. The road calls.
They say {nome} has died once already.
Everyone has died once. Ask the Eye.
fofoca.sombra: Hide the purse. And the chickens.
Me too. And I believe half, which is plenty.
Because nobody wants to be the first to try.
fofoca.feito.bom: Heard it at the tavern. I bought a round in their honor.
I can. Saw it with my own eyes.
fofoca.feito.mau: May the Eye have mercy on them. I won't.
Lock your door tonight, all right?
